scope: This closes the first-moment character-sum side of fixed-curve coverage at an explicit field-size threshold. The separate Semaev nondegeneracy and total-energy estimate, its collector binding, and the end-to-end ECDLP runtime theorem remain open.
statement: For every nonsingular short Weierstrass curve over an odd finite field of cardinality at least 324 and every positive finite set of nonzero abscissas, at least one sixth of all nonzero dilations have a concrete signed factor-base fibre count at least half the abscissa count.
